entries.description: A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block rendering a single accordion item with a title attribute and content attribute, escaped, that expands/collapses.
A settings page with a dismissible admin notice for editors.
A contact form shortcode with AJAX submission, storing submissions as private CPT
Fetches next page of approved comments via AJAX using [load_comments] shortcode, supporting logged-out users.
A shortcode with category buttons that fetches published posts via AJAX, allowing logged-out users with proper nonce and capability checks.
A [star_rating] shortcode showing 1-5 stars for the current post. Submitting a rating via AJAX (logged-out allowed) updates a running average in post meta.

A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block that renders a dismissible alert banner with a 'type' attribute (info/success/warning/error) and a message attribute, all escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
Provides a public REST endpoint for published announcements with proper security and sanitization.
Displays the post author's name and description in the sidebar on single posts with a customizable heading.
A Book Review CPT with meta fields for author and a 1-5 rating (clamped), editable in a secure meta box, plus an admin Rating column showing stars.
A Business CPT with hierarchical Category and Region taxonomies, plus a [directory] shortcode for listing businesses.
Display business opening hours via settings page and shortcode.

A classic sidebar widget rendering a heading, a short message, and a button (label + URL) from its instance settings, all escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
A custom post type for case studies with client and outcome meta, admin column, and shortcode.
Stores and displays contact information (phone, email, address) via a settings page and shortcode.
An admin dashboard widget showing counts of published posts, pages, and comments, visible only to users who can edit posts.
A Recipe CPT with Course and Cuisine taxonomies, and a [recipes] shortcode.
Adds a dismissible cookie consent banner in the footer with customizable message and button label.

A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block that renders a countdown to a target date attribute (sanitized), showing days remaining, escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.

A classic sidebar widget with a target-date instance setting (sanitized) that renders the number of days remaining, escaped, with a configurable title. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
A custom post type for managing coupons with code and expiry date, featuring an admin column and shortcode.
A plugin for managing courses with hierarchical subject and level taxonomies.
A shortcode for rendering a styled call-to-action button with sanitized URL and escaped text.
A [current_year] shortcode that outputs the current four-digit year (useful for footers). Escaped output. No settings.
A plugin to replace the WordPress admin footer text with a customizable value.
Adds a settings page to customize site footer text with basic HTML support.
Adds a settings page for custom <head> markup (e.g., analytics/meta tags) output via wp_head, with admin-only access and full sanitization.
Outputs the number of whole days since a specified start date via a shortcode.
A settings page with a toggle to disable comments site-wide. When enabled, closes comments on all post types and hides existing comments.
A Download CPT with a file-URL meta and a download-count meta (secure meta box) and a [downloads] shortcode listing published downloads as escaped links.
Automatically trashes auto-draft posts older than 7 days via weekly cron, records counts in options.
Event CPT with start-date and location meta, admin Start Date column, and [events] shortcode for upcoming events. All output escaped, input sanitized, with nonce and capability checks.
Registers an Events custom post type with a read-only REST API endpoint for published events.
Adds rel='noopener' and visual markers to external links in post content with a settings toggle.
Provides a custom post type for FAQs with a public REST API endpoint.
Creates an FAQ custom post type with question/answer fields and a shortcode to display FAQs as an accordion.

A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block rendering a feature box with an icon name, heading, and description attribute, all escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
A Photo Custom Post Type with secure caption meta and a public REST API endpoint for published photos.
A custom post type for glossary terms with a shortcode to display them alphabetically.
A very small plugin that provides a single shortcode [greeting_box] for the front end.

Schedule a daily WP-Cron event that records a heartbeat timestamp and the current published-post count into an option (keep the last 14). Register/clear on activation/deactivation. A [healthcheck] shortcode shows the latest entry, escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
A ticketing system with hierarchical status tracking, admin columns, and REST API endpoints.
A Job CPT with meta for location, employment type, and salary range, admin columns, and [jobs] shortcode.
A plugin providing a hierarchical Topic taxonomy for Articles, with a shortcode to list articles by topic.
A [load_more] shortcode listing recent published posts with a button that loads the next page via AJAX (available logged-out).
A Location CPT with latitude and longitude meta (secure meta box, sanitized) and a public read-only REST endpoint (GET) returning id, title, lat, and lng for published locations.
Adds a settings page to replace the WordPress login logo with a custom image URL.
Enable maintenance mode with a custom message for non-logged-in visitors.
A Movie CPT with a rating meta (secure meta box) and a Genre taxonomy, plus a [movies genre=""] shortcode listing published movies by genre.

A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block that outputs an info/warning notice with a type attribute and message, escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
Manage podcast episodes with audio URL, duration meta, and season taxonomy.
A classic sidebar widget listing the N most-commented published posts with configurable count and heading.
A plugin for showcasing agency projects with custom post type, taxonomy, shortcode, and AJAX load-more functionality.
Work CPT with non-hierarchical Skill taxonomy (tags) and work_grid shortcode for filtering published works.
Schedule weekly archiving of old posts to private status with count tracking.
Custom Post Type for press releases with date meta and shortcode listing.

A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block rendering a single pricing tier: plan name, price, and a list of features from block attributes, all escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check.
A catalog of products with hierarchical categories and a shortcode for listing.
A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block for displaying person profile cards with name, title, and bio.
A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block for styled pull quotes with quote and citation attributes.
Adds a [quick_search] shortcode that provides title suggestions via AJAX for published posts.
A shortcode displaying emoji reaction buttons for posts, with AJAX click tracking stored in post meta.
A settings page with an enable toggle and bar color; when enabled, render an escaped reading-progress bar on single posts.
A plugin for managing real estate listings with properties as a custom post type.
A classic sidebar widget listing the N most recent approved comments with escaped author and excerpt and a configurable count.
A sidebar widget listing the N most recent published posts of a 'product' post type if present (else posts), with escaped titles and configurable count.
A Recipe Custom Post Type with meta fields for prep time and servings, secure meta box, and recipe_card shortcode.
Manages restaurant menu items with price and dietary notes, featuring a shortcode for displaying published items.
Automates deletion of old post revisions with configurable retention (keeps 5 most recent per post, deletes older than 60 days). Records deleted count in option.
Schedules daily cache purging via WP-Cron, deletes expired option-based cache entries, records last run time, and manages cron schedules on activation/deactivation.
Adds a scroll to top button in the footer with customizable settings.
Adds a default meta description field and outputs it in wp_head when missing.
A plugin for managing services with a custom post type, price and icon meta, and a shortcode to list services.
Custom post type for services with price meta and public REST API endpoint.

A Contact CPT with meta fields for email and phone (secure meta box), a hierarchical Status taxonomy (e.g. Lead/Customer), an admin Status column, and a [contacts status=""] shortcode listing contacts by status, escaped. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check. Remove data and terms on uninstall.
Stores social profile URLs via a settings page and displays them as configurable sidebar links with proper escaping and sanitization.
A Staff Custom Post Type with meta fields for job title and phone, secure meta box, and a [staff_list] shortcode.
A dynamic server-rendered Gutenberg block displaying a statistic with a label.
Stores daily snapshots of published post and comment counts, accessible via shortcode.
Member Custom Post Type with role meta and public REST API endpoint.
A plugin for managing team members with a custom post type and department taxonomy.

A Team Member CPT (title = name, editor = bio) with meta fields for role and email, editable in a secure meta box, plus an admin Role column. Escape all output, sanitize all input, and pair every state-changing action with a nonce AND a capability check. Clean up on uninstall.
Manage client testimonials with ratings, customer details, and admin display.
Testimonial CPT with author meta field and public REST endpoint for published testimonials.
Automatically cleans up expired cache entries stored as options with a scheduled daily task.
Custom post type for tutorials with difficulty taxonomy and shortcode listing.
A shortcode for yes/no polls with AJAX voting, storing counts in options.
Schedules a weekly cron event to count posts published in the last 7 days and displays the count via a shortcode.
